column1: # Words Assamese speakers routinely write in Assamese script but which are NOT
# phonetically derivable from the Assamese phonetic rules: English spelling
# says little about English sound, and Assamese has its own habits for English
# sounds on top — an English s is usually চ or ছ ("office" অফিচ, "bus" বাছ),
# an English short o is ' or ো ("mobile" ম'বাইল), "a" in "bank" is এ (বেংক).
# Typed on the Assamese phonetic layout, the English spelling on the left
# resolves directly to the Assamese form on the right, ahead of the rules and of
# A hand-written draft that wants an Assamese speaker's review. Every spelling
# was checked against the Assamese word list in wmkeyboard-data
# (data/as/as_full.txt.gz); where the list has two spellings, the commoner one
# comes first. A wrong entry here is worse than a missing one, since it
# Format: english<TAB>assamese   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
